programme.title: TUDOR NAZARÉ Big Wave Challenge
programme.sub-title: 2025 TUDOR NAZARÉ Big Wave Challenge
programme.desc: The deepwater canyon of Portugal's famous Nazaré set the stage for Big Wave's finest to battle for the 2025 Tudor Nazaré Big Wave Challenge. Heavy wipeouts, full sends, and a clash of defending champs taking on perennial Big Wave standouts provided plenty of adrenaline-pumping action. Nic Von Rupp and Clement Roseyro emerged victorious with Justine Dupont stamping her authority at the arena of Nazaré once more to top the women's leaderboard alongside Roseyro taking the men's leaderboard win.

programme.title: Kelly Slater: The Lost Tapes
programme.sub-title: Kelly Slater: Lost Tapes | The Old World - Episode 10
programme.desc: When the tour moves on to Europe, Kelly reconnects with one of his oldest and closest friends, Stephen "Belly" Bell, a longtime tour manager who's retiring after the season. Disappointing results in France and Portugal, combined with his friend's retirement, force Kelly to consider his own career timeline.

programme.title: Kelly Slater: The Lost Tapes
programme.sub-title: Kelly Slater: Lost Tapes | Curtain Call - Episode 11
programme.desc: In the finale, Kelly arrives on the North Shore of Oahu earlier than usual and decides to surf the Triple Crown in the lead-up to the final Championship Tour event at Pipeline. With a run of good swell and the eyes of the entire surfing world on Pipe, Kelly ends the season on a high note by scoring a perfect 10, winning his first Triple Crown in 21 years, and finishing the season ranked 8th overall.

programme.title: All In: Life on the WSL Championship Tour
programme.sub-title: All In | Carissa And Lakey Face Their Final World Tour Battle In Perfect Honolua Bay
programme.desc: As Carissa Moore, Lakey Peterson, and the rest of the women of the WSL World Tour arrive to Honolua Bay, Maui, so too does one of the biggest swells in recent memory. For Carissa, who grew up in Hawaii, big waves come more naturally. For Lakey, a terrifying wipeout earlier in her career lingers in her mind as she sets out to clinch the world title in a surf-off with Stephanie Gilmore. Meanwhile, on the North Shore, Julian Wilson and Jordy Smith prepare for battle at the Banzai Pipeline.

programme.title: Brilliant Corners
programme.sub-title: Casbah Coast | Brilliant Corners: Algeria, Episode 1
programme.desc: Host and Longboard Champion Sam Bleakley travels to Algeria with Australian longboarder and writer Lucy Small, French surfer and adventurer Erwan Simon, and local Dihya Nasri, the only female surfer in all of Algeria. They continue to explore the over 1,000 miles of mostly unsurfed Mediterranean coastline, paddling out at a slabbing wave near the capital city of Algiers. Sam Bleakley, Lucy Small, Erwan Simon, and Dihya Nasri have a dawn patrol session at a nearby break and meet some of the local surfers in the tight-knit community as they continue to explore Algeria, one of the Brilliant Corners of the earth.
